text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Arisa and {0} have planned to meet on the outskirts of Landosol.
text_block_list.orig_text: {0}とアリサは、郊外で待ち合わせをしていた。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, {0}!
What's the plan for today?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おはよう、
{0}くん！
今日はなにするの？

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Ideally we'll finally find Losa—
Wait, {0}?!
Wh-why're you grabbing my hand out of the blue?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日こそロザリアが見つかるといいな……
……って、
{0}くん！？
き、
急にて、
てて、
手にぎってどうしたのっ！？

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whoa!
No need to drag me along!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひゃ、
ひゃあ！？
{0}くん、引っ張らないでっ！？

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
*huff, huff*
That sure was a surprise...
My heart's still racing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ、
はぁ……
びっくりしちゃった……
まだドキドキしてるよ……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Hm?
The atmosphere around here seems a bit... different?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あれ？
ここ、
なんだろう……
いつもと全然違うみたい……？

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Really?!
Wow. This is the biggest harvest festival I've ever seen.
Anything goes in Landosol, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
収穫祭！？
……そっかぁ、
こんなにおっきいんだね。
ランドソルはなんでもすごいなー。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, wait!
Is [i]this[/i] why you arranged for us to meet today?
choice_data_list: You've been working hard, so yeah.
I was hoping we could make the most of it together.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あっ！
もしかして{0}くん、
今日はここに連れてきてくれたの？

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Y-you think?
I haven't been doing anything that special...
But, well. Hearing it from you makes me happy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そうかなぁ……
私はその、
ふつーにしてるけど……
……でも、
うれしいな。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
H-huh?!
Together?!
W-Wow... That [i]does[/i] make me happy, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
ええええぇっ！？
私とってこと！？
そ、
そんな……
うれしいけど……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Well. Thanks, {0}.
Truth is, not being able to find any leads
on Losaria has left me feeling pretty down lately.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ありがとね、{0}くん。
実は最近、
困ってたんだ。
ロザリアの手がかり、
なかなか見つからなくて。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
And I kept blaming myself for it, too.
Which made me feel even worse.
But the fact that you brought me here's cheered me up a bit!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私だめだなぁ、って。
ちょっと落ち込んじゃったりして……
でも、
ここに来たら少しだけ元気出たよ！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure she'd be upset if she saw me being all sad, too.
She's super kind like that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……私が元気なくしてたら、
きっとロザリアも悲しむよね。
ロザリア、
優しいから……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Right!
No point in being all depressed while I'm here.
I'm gonna make the most of it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……よし！
せっかく連れてきてもらえたんだし、
今日はできるだけ楽しむねっ！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
And hey. I might even find a lead or two
on Losaria while we're here!
So yeah, let's get going!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに、
もしかしたらロザリアの手がかりが
ここにあるかもしれないしっ！
そうと決まれば、
行こっ！
　{0}くん！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
{0}!
I got us some drinks!
I'll be right o—Whoa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん！　
はい、飲み物持ってきたよ！
……って、
わとと！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Sorry about that.
I should settle down a bit.
That said, let's—
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あはは、
ごめんなさい。
慌てちゃ駄目だね。
それじゃ、
改めて――

text_block_list.name: Woman 1
text_block_list.text: Hey hey. How about joining us for some drinks?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お兄さん、
よければこっちで一緒に飲みませんかー？

text_block_list.name: Woman 2
text_block_list.text: Yeah! It'll be a load of fun!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうですよー、
一緒に楽しみましょー！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha.
Look at Mr. Popular over here.
I get it, though, considering how kind you are.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あはは。
{0}くん、
人気者だよね。
でも分かるな、
だって優しいもん。

text_block_list.name: Woman 1
text_block_list.text: Wew! ♪ Make room for the lovebirds, ladies.
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃー♪　
ノロケられちゃったー♪

text_block_list.name: Woman 2
text_block_list.text: Sorry. We didn't mean to interrupt you two. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
私たちはお邪魔ね♪　
失礼しまーす。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
L-lovebirds?!
No, no! You've got it all wrong!
text_block_list.orig_text:
の、
ノロケっ！？
違うんですけどっ、
あ、あのー！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
And off they go...
Th-that got a bit weird, didn't it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……行っちゃった。
……な、
なんか変な感じになっちゃったね！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
S-sorry.
They made the effort to come speak to you,
but I kind of ruined the mood...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ご、
ごめんねっ。
私が余計なこと言っちゃったから……
あの人たち、
せっかく来てくれたのに。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
If anything, you'd be better off
spending time with pretty girls like tha—
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに、
{0}くんだって、
私といるより、
きれいなお姉さんといたほうが……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh...
You're really too kind for your own good.
Sometimes it kinda catches me off guard.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……うぅ。
{0}くんはいつも優しいね。
けど、
たまに照れちゃうよ……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
A-anyway!
Let's toast!
One, two, three! Cheers!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……え、
えっと！
それじゃ、
乾杯しよっか！
せーの、
かんぱーい！

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Gather up, everyone!
The beauty pageant's about to start!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はーい！　
それではこれよりミスコンをはじめまーす！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Hm?
Hey, {0}.
What's a beauty pageant?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミスコン？
ねぇ、{0}くん。
ミスコンってなに？

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh. So they determine who's the prettiest?
Honestly, there's probably a ton
of pretty people here considering how big Landosol is.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……へぇ、
一番きれいな人を選ぶんだ！
ランドソルって、
色んな人いるもんね。
きっとみんなきれいなんだろうなー。

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
As for this year's contestants, we'll be picking them out from
the crowd! First up, we'll take you two lovely ladies over there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今年度の出場者はこの場から決めたいと思います！
それでは……
そこのお二人、
お願いします！

text_block_list.name: Woman 1
text_block_list.text: Heehee. ♪ Good to know that you've got some taste. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
うふふ♪　
あなた、見る目あるじゃない♪

text_block_list.name: Woman 2
text_block_list.text: Not that I expected any less. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
当然ね♪

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh! They're the two from earlier!
Wow, they actually got picked!
We've gotta cheer them o—
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！　
さっきの人たちだよ！
すごいね！　
選ばれてるみたいっ！
応援してあげないと――

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text: Last up is... You! The cloaked elf girl over there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そして最後に……
はい！
　そこのマントを羽織ったエルフのキミ！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
W-wait, what?!
For real?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
――え？
え、
え、
えっ！？
えぇぇぇぇっ！？

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text: First up, we have the dance contest!
text_block_list.orig_text: それではまずダンスです！

text_block_list.name: Woman 1
text_block_list.text: I did plenty of dance lessons at school. This'll be a cinch. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
学校の授業でやったことあるし、
かんたーん♪

text_block_list.name: Woman 2
text_block_list.text: Easy-peasy. All those festivals back home will come in handy. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
私も
村のお祭りでよく踊るし
問題ないはずよ♪

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Wow-wee! Now that's impressive stuff!
As for Arisa—
text_block_list.orig_text:
おー、
これは見事だー！
一方のアリサさんはー！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
U-uhh...
Is this how you do it?
...Waugh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だ、
ダンスって……
こんな感じかな……
……
ふぎゃっ！

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text: It's not looking good, folks!
text_block_list.orig_text: 苦戦しておりまーす！

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text: Next up is the singing contest!
text_block_list.orig_text: 続いて歌の披露です！

text_block_list.name: Woman 1
text_block_list.text: La-la. ♪ La-la-la. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ら～
ららら～♪

text_block_list.name: Woman 2
text_block_list.text: Hmm. ♪ Hmm-hmm-hmm. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
る～
るるる～♪

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Yet another fantastic display! Truly marvelous!
But what does our lovely elven lady have in store for us?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おー、
これは見事な歌声です！
　素晴らしい！
さぁ、
アリサさんはどんな歌を披露してくれるのかー！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
S-singing's, uh...
Doo-bee-doo...
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
歌っ……
ふ、ふんふふーん……

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text: It's just plain old humming!
text_block_list.orig_text: なんと鼻歌だー！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text: Because I plain can't sing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だって
歌えないよー！

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Now then! It's time to strut your stuff!
Show us one of your specialties!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さぁ、
最後はそれぞれの特技を披露していただきます！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Urgh, this just keeps getting worse...
Why did he have to pick me?!
I don't wanna look dumb while {0}'s watching...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅ、
どうしよう……
なんで私が選ばれちゃったんだろ……！
{0}くんも見てるし、
恥ずかしいよ……！

text_block_list.name: Ruffians
text_block_list.text: Wahey!
text_block_list.orig_text: ひゃっはー！

text_block_list.name: Woman 1
text_block_list.text: Eeek!
text_block_list.orig_text: キャー！

text_block_list.name: Ruffian 1
text_block_list.text:
Heh! Now [i]this[/i] looks like a party! Let us in on it!
I spy with my little eye, some pretty fine ladies!
text_block_list.orig_text:
へへへ、
随分楽しそうだなー、
俺たちも交ぜてくれよ！
おお、
いい女はっけーん！

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text: Wh-what's with you two?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんだキミたちは！

text_block_list.name: Ruffian 2
text_block_list.text:
Shut it, loser! You got a problem with us being here?
Heehee! Mosey on over here, babes. We'll show you a good time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うるせぇ！
　文句あんのかぁ！
へっへっへ……
嬢ちゃんたち、
こっちにきな……
可愛がってやるぜ。

text_block_list.name: Woman 2
text_block_list.text: S-someone help...
text_block_list.orig_text:
い、
いや、
誰か……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
...!
Don't you dare lay a finger on them!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ！
駄目だよ！
　この人たちを傷付けないで！

text_block_list.name: Ruffian 1
text_block_list.text: Wassat?! You wanna step to us, do ya?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ！？
　んだおまえ！
　やんのかよー！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's here to enjoy the festival!
Don't ruin it like this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お祭りなんだから、
楽しまなきゃ駄目だよ！
こんなひどいことしないで……！

text_block_list.name: Ruffian 1
text_block_list.text:
Shut yer trap, will ya?!
Or maybe we'll shut it for ya!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ、
うるせーんだよ！
　なめやがって！
　おらぁ！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
...!
I told you to quit it already!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ！
やめてって言ってるでしょっ！

text_block_list.name: Ruffian 1
text_block_list.text: Grugh! The heck?! She ain't no pushover!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐっ！
　なんだこいつ、つえーぞ！？

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
If you two want to be selfish and ruin things for everyone else,
then I'll make sure you regret it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんなのためのお祭りだもん……！
ひどいことなんて、
させないよ！

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
S-simply incredible, folks!
She's practically running circles around them!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
これはすごいぞー！
アリサさん、華麗な動きで敵を翻弄！

text_block_list.name: Woman 1
text_block_list.text: Amazing! Keep it up, Arisa!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごーい！
　アリサちゃんいけいけー！

text_block_list.name: Woman 2
text_block_list.text: You're so cool! Knock 'em out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
かっこいいー！
　そんなやつら倒しちゃえー！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text: Down you go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……これで、
おしまいっ！

text_block_list.name: Ruffians
text_block_list.text: Waaaggghhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ギャー！

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Well, folks! There we have it!
Give it up for Arisa, winner of this year's annual beauty pageant!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アリサさんの勝利です！
そして、
今年のミスコンの優勝は、
アリサさんでーす！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
I-I won?!
[i]Me[/i]?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
へ？
ゆ、
優勝っ！？
私がっ！？

text_block_list.name: Woman 1
text_block_list.text: That was awesome! You were so cool!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アリサちゃん凄かった！
　超クールだった！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
N-not at all!
The two of you were much more impressive!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そんなこと……！
お二人だって、
凄かったです……！

text_block_list.name: Woman 2
text_block_list.text:
We couldn't dream of pulling off what you did!
Cute and strong. You're basically perfect!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんなの私たちにはできないよ！
可愛くて強いとか
完璧じゃん！

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's not true at all...
I'm not that strong, and I'm definitely not cute...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そんな……
かわいくないですし、
つよくなんて……

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
Thanks!
Ehehe.
I'm still a bit flustered, but also really happy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……うん！
えへへ……
なんか、
よく分かんないけど……
うれしいな。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to you.
I never would have found the courage
if I didn't know you were watching.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くんのおかげだよ。
{0}くんが見ててくれたから……
だから、
勇気を出せたんだ。

text_block_list.name: Arisa
text_block_list.text:
So thank you, {0}.
That said, the festival's still going on.
And there's plenty I wanna see, too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう、
{0}くん。
……お祭りが終わるまで、
よろしくね？
私、
もっと色んなもの見てみたいから！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
And thus the festival went on,
becoming a night that Arisa would never forget.
text_block_list.orig_text:
祭りは夜通し続き、この日の出来事はアリサにとって、
大切な思い出になるのだった。
